title: Learning wisely
simplified_paragraphs: 在《论语》中，孔子对他的学生说，我教你们一个做事情的方法，你们应该聪明地想到别的方法，如果不能，我不会再教你们了。
大家就把孔子的话变成了“举一反三”这个成语，意思是说，学东西，应该聪明地用到很多别的事情上。
traditional_paragraphs: 在《論語》中，孔子對他的學生說，我教你們一個做事情的方法，你們應該聰明地想到別的方法，如果不能，我不會再教你們了。
大家就把孔子的話變成了“舉一反三”這個成語，意思是說，學東西，應該聰明地用到很多別的事情上。
pinyin_paragraphs: zài《 Lún yǔ》 zhōng， Kǒng zǐ duì tā de xué shēng shuō， wǒ jiāo nǐ men yī gè zuò shì qing de fāng fǎ， nǐ men yīng gāi cōng míng de xiǎng dào bié de fāng fǎ， rú guǒ bù néng， wǒ bù huì zài jiāo nǐ men le。
dà jiā jiù bǎ Kǒng zǐ de huà biàn chéng le“ jǔ yī fǎn sān” zhè ge chéng yǔ， yì si shì shuō， xué dōng xi， yīng gāi cōng míng de yòng dào hěn duō bié de shì qing shàng。
english_paragraphs: In the Analects, Confucius told his students, “If I teach you one way to do something, you should be able to think of other ways on your own. If you can’t, I won’t teach you any more.”
People later turned his words into the idiom “ju yi fan san,” which means that when you learn something, you should be able to apply it to many other things.
english_full:
In the Analects, Confucius told his students, “If I teach you one way to do something, you should be able to think of other ways on your own. If you can’t, I won’t teach you any more.”

People later turned his words into the idiom “ju yi fan san,” which means that when you learn something, you should be able to apply it to many other things.
